title: coelorachis pubescens
intro: Coelorachis pubescens, commonly known as the hairy spike-grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Coelorachis pubescens include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal agent, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
